createfactorytweaks.configuration.title: Create: Factory Tweaks
createfactorytweaks.configuration.lockDe: When locked, burner fuel values use built-in defaults and distillation uses Vanilla. Unlock to edit fuel values or choose Adjusted or Custom distillation.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.enable: Allow the supported TFMG fuels to use these blaze burner settings. Ignored while settings are locked.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.pipeTr: Maximum fluid accepted per pipe transfer. Buckets can still insert a full bucket.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.charge: Amount of liquid consumed for each burner charge.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.fuelEn: Allow this fuel to burn using the configured settings.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.heatLe: NONE disables burning. KINDLED provides normal heat. SEETHING provides superheated heat.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.blazeB: Choose a fuel to adjust its burner settings.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.liquid: Shared by normal and liquid blaze burners. A full bucket grants ten times this duration. Liquid charges scale with their fluid amount. Changes affect newly added fuel; zero disables burning.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.adjust: Use the built-in adjusted distillation amounts.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.vanill: Original TFMG recipe outputs, including any datapack changes.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.output: Reference output for heavy oil. Original reference: 120 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 120, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for diesel. Original reference: 60 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 60, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for kerosene. Original reference: 30 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 30, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for naphtha. Original reference: 10 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 10, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for gasoline. Original reference: 60 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 60, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for lpg. Original reference: 60 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 60, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
Reference output for lubrication oil. Original reference: 25 mB. Other recipe outputs are multiplied by this value divided by 25, then rounded to the nearest mB. Minimum output: 1 mB.
createfactorytweaks.configuration.distil: Reference mB per fluid. Recipe variants scale from their original values.
Vanilla uses original TFMG amounts; Adjusted uses built-in amounts; Custom uses the editable output values.
